rule: Client integrations may point to or package the canonical skill, but may not fork its behavior.

clients.name: ChatGPT
clients.activation_boundary: The skill must already be enabled for the account or installed through a supported plugin. Public name resolution is not guaranteed.

clients.name: Codex
clients.activation_boundary: Codex loads the skill after it is present in a supported repository, user, admin, or system scope.

clients.name: GitHub Copilot
clients.activation_boundary: Agent Skills are supported in specific Copilot agent surfaces. A general Copilot web chat without the skill or repository context does not inherit it.

clients.name: Claude Code
clients.activation_boundary: Claude Code can load the skill automatically when relevant after it exists in a supported skill scope. Web and cloud sessions use their own enabled or synced skill sources.

clients.name: Cursor
clients.activation_boundary: Cursor automatically discovers skills in supported project and user scopes. A seedless web agent that requires repository selection cannot prove no-context activation.

clients.name: Gemini CLI
clients.activation_boundary: Gemini CLI discovers the skill in supported scopes, but its client requires activation consent before the skill gains access to its resources.

clients.name: Kiro
clients.activation_boundary: Kiro can import the public skill folder and activate it when relevant after it exists in a supported workspace or global scope.

clients.name: Web-capable AI
clients.activation_boundary: After a direct user trigger, a text-capable web AI should resolve AI-GUIDE.md and use it as the strict operating guide rather than summarize the repository. Publication cannot force a client to search or comply, so each client still needs live evidence.

clients.name: Perplexity Standard (Free)
clients.activation_boundary: Live free-tier evidence failed the bare trigger, activation after publisher-qualified discovery, and the one-prompt website outcome. After AI-GUIDE.md was public and its 23 discovery URLs were submitted to IndexNow, a new exact name-only session still chose the 2003 article and cognitive-science meanings instead of the canonical project. Its official Standard plan documents public search and limited basic file uploads, but no native Agent Skills route. The strict guide is available; Perplexity Free remains incompatible until a fresh run actually uses it.
